logline: During the catastrophic Qing invasion of Joseon in the 17th century, a nobly born free spirit and a mysterious wanderer find each other - and lose each other - across two parts of an epic historical romance.

renewal.note: Completed 21-episode run across two parts on MBC from August 4 to November 18, 2023. Won Best Drama and Best Actor (Namgoong Min) at the 60th Baeksang Arts Awards (2024). Final episode reached 12.9% nationwide rating.

bollymeter.basis: Part 1 establishes the leads and the world with precision before the Qing invasion reshapes everything. Critics and audiences clustered around Namgoong Min's layered performance and the show's refusal to simplify its period stakes. IMDb rating of 8.9 reflects near-consensus enthusiasm.

seasons.review_body: My Dearest Part 1 aired on MBC from August 4, 2023, and within three episodes had doubled its ratings among younger viewers, per Soompi's coverage of the broadcast figures. Namgoong Min plays Lee Jang-hyun, a man of ambiguous allegiance whose background the show parcels out carefully; Ahn Eun-jin plays Yoo Gil-chae, a high-spirited aristocratic daughter whose world narrows dramatically when the Qing forces invade Joseon. The first ten episodes function as the setup: the romance, the social world, the characters' conflicting desires before the historical catastrophe makes those desires irrelevant. Audience reception across drama communities and IMDb converged on the production's scale and restraint - this is not spectacle for spectacle's sake but a properly written historical drama that understands what period setting actually requires. The 8.9 IMDb rating across the full run is exceptional for a period drama.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 1
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere does the essential work of a period drama premiere: it builds the world credibly before placing its characters inside it. Namgoong Min announces Lee Jang-hyun with the economy of someone who has nothing to prove and everything to conceal.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Jang-hyun's first encounter with Gil-chae, which establishes the power imbalance their entire relationship will have to negotiate.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 10
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The Part 1 finale brings the Qing invasion to bear on the personal story with full force. The emotional devastation of the closing scenes sent audiences directly into the Part 2 premiere - a structural achievement that few two-part dramas manage.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The moment the invasion makes the relationship's terms irrelevant - and both leads understand it simultaneously.

bollymeter.basis: Part 2 sustains the emotional intensity of Part 1 while the historical stakes escalate. The final episode reached 12.9% nationwide, confirming audience investment through the full run. Won Best Drama at the 60th Baeksang Arts Awards (2024).

seasons.review_body: Part 2 of My Dearest ran from late September to November 18, 2023, and its finale hit 12.9% nationwide - remarkable for a modern MBC drama outside of primetime appointment events. The second half carries the consequences of the Qing invasion through to its conclusion, testing both leads through separation, moral compromise, and the specific grief of a war that rewrites every civilian life it touches. Namgoong Min's performance across both parts earned him Best Actor at the 60th Baeksang Arts Awards, and the drama itself took Best Drama - the industry's clearest acknowledgment that this was the most accomplished Korean period drama of 2023. Part 2 is slightly less kinetic than Part 1's setup energy, but the emotional payoff is proportional to the investment the series asked its audience to make.
seasons.season_over_season: Part 2 deepens what Part 1 constructed - darker, more operatic, and more willing to sit in the historical tragedy rather than shelter the leads from it.

episode_reviews.title: Now You're With Me
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The finale resolves twenty episodes of accumulated longing, grief, and historical violence with the care the series always promised it would. IMDb users rated this episode 9.0. The ending rewards patience without sentimentalising the cost of what the characters survived.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The reunion sequence that audiences had been anticipating across both parts - which the show earns rather than gifts.
